ai.personalDescription: Your requests use your OpenRouter account and its models, credits, and limits. Thought Box stores only an encrypted copy of your key and a masked hint.
ai.platformDescription: Thought Box provides the AI connection for you. You do not need to create an OpenRouter key to use the platform provider.
ai.keyInvalidWarning: This key was rejected by OpenRouter. Add a new key to restore personal AI.
ai.replaceKeyDescription: Enter a new key to replace the current one.
ai.addKeyDescription: Bring your own key if you want AI requests billed and rate-limited by your OpenRouter account.
ai.keySecurityNote: The key is sent directly to the Thought Box API over HTTPS, verified against OpenRouter, then encrypted before storage. It is never displayed in full after saving.
ai.removeDescription: Delete your stored OpenRouter key and switch back to the platform provider.
ai.removeConfirm: Remove your personal OpenRouter key? Thought Box will use the platform provider again.
ai.saveSuccess: Your OpenRouter key was verified and saved securely.
ai.removeSuccess: Your personal key was removed. Thought Box is using the platform provider.
ai.saveError: Could not save the OpenRouter key.
ai.removeError: Could not remove the OpenRouter key.
